designProcessSection.title: Our Design Process
designProcessSection.description: From concept to completion, we follow a streamlined process that ensures every project is delivered with creativity, precision, and exceptional attention to detail.

steps.title: Initial Consultation
steps.description: We begin by understanding your vision, lifestyle, goals, budget, and design preferences.

steps.title: Concept Development
steps.description: Our designers create mood boards, layouts, and design concepts tailored to your space.

steps.title: Design Planning
steps.description: Detailed plans, material selections, color palettes, and furniture layouts are finalized.

steps.title: Project Execution
steps.description: Our team manages procurement, installation, and construction while ensuring quality standards.

steps.title: Final Styling
steps.description: Decor, lighting, artwork, and finishing touches are carefully placed to complete the space.

steps.title: Project Handover
steps.description: We conduct a final walkthrough to ensure every detail exceeds your expectations.
